settings.keys: F6 settings · F8 force feedback off · F7 camera view

controls.text: Set up your wheel in the game's Controls menu.

controls.label: Wheel D-pad in menus
controls.help: Use your wheel's D-pad in the game's menus.

ffb.text: Waiting for the game to create its effects

ffb.label: Force feedback
ffb.help: F8 turns it off at any time.

ffb.label: Strength
ffb.help: 50% is the game's own strength; 100% doubles it.

ffb.label: Normalize effect gain
ffb.help: For wheels that ignore the game's effect gain. Adds Strength.

display.label: Screens
display.help: Center screen, a wide span, or angle-correct triple screens.

display.label: Panel width
display.help: The visible picture width of one screen.

display.label: Panel height
display.help: The visible picture height of one screen.

display.label: Eye distance
display.help: From your eyes to the center screen, level with its edges.

display.label: Side screens angle
display.help: How far the side screens turn toward you (0 = flat).

display.label: This session
display.text: Center screen: the game's own display

display.label: Curve radius
display.help: 0 for flat screens; 1500R curved screens are 1500.

display.label: Right screen angle
display.help: Only the right screen, after Side screens angle.

display.label: Bezel gap
display.help: The gap between the pictures of two screens.

display.label: Eye height
display.help: Eyes above the center of the screens.

cameras.text: F7 switches Game and Realistic FOV. Numpad + and - zoom, 5 resets.

cameras.label: Switch FOV (F7)
cameras.help: Game FOV is GRID's own zoom; Realistic is seat-true.

cameras.label: Default FOV
cameras.help: Restores only this camera's FOV offset.

telemetry.text: GRID sends its own UDP. Change it in GRID's settings, then restart.

help.label: Report a problem
help.help: Saves a report on your Desktop and opens the mod's page.
